title: Leave Policy
text:
Acme Corp Leave Policy

Annual Leave

Every full-time employee receives 25 days of paid annual leave per calendar year. Part-time employees receive a proportional amount. Leave accrues monthly and may be taken from the first month of employment.

Carry Over

Up to 5 unused annual leave days can be carried over into the next year. Carried-over days expire on 31 March, and days not taken by then are lost without compensation.

Requesting Leave

Leave requests are submitted in the HR portal at least 14 days before the first day of absence. Managers answer within 3 working days. Requests for more than 10 consecutive days need approval from the department director.

Sick Leave

Employees receive 10 days of paid sick leave per year. A medical certificate is required after 3 consecutive days of absence. Employees must inform their manager before 10:00 on the first day of illness.

Parental Leave

The primary caregiver receives 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave, and the second parent receives 6 weeks. Parental leave can be taken in one block or split into two blocks within the first 12 months after the birth or adoption.

Unpaid Leave

Employees with at least two years of service may request unpaid leave of up to 3 months. The request needs written approval from the department director and HR. Benefits are suspended during unpaid leave.

Public Holidays

Acme observes the public holidays of the country in which the employee's contract is based. If a public holiday falls on a weekend, no replacement day is granted. Employees who work on a public holiday receive a day off in lieu within 60 days.

Bereavement Leave

Employees receive 5 paid days after the death of a spouse, child or parent, and 2 paid days after the death of another close relative. Additional unpaid time can be agreed with the manager.

title: Expense Reimbursement Policy
text:
Acme Corp Expense Reimbursement Policy

Submitting Claims

Expense claims must be submitted in the finance portal within 30 days of the expense date. Late claims are only paid with written approval from the Finance Director.

Receipts

An itemised receipt is required for every expense above 25 USD. For expenses of 25 USD or less, a short description in the claim is enough.

Meals

While travelling, meals are reimbursed up to 60 USD per day. Alcohol is never reimbursed, even when it is part of a client dinner.

Approval Limits

Managers approve claims up to 500 USD. Claims above 500 USD also need approval from the department director before payment.

Payment

Approved claims are paid with the next payroll run, and no later than 10 business days after approval. Employees can follow the status of each claim in the finance portal.

Mileage

Business use of a private car is reimbursed at 0.45 USD per kilometre. Employees must record the start and end point of each trip and the purpose of the visit.

Phone Allowance

Employees who need a mobile phone for their work receive a flat allowance of 30 USD per month. The allowance is paid with the salary and is not part of the expense claim process.

Client Entertainment

Client dinners need prior approval from a director and a list of attendees. The limit is 100 USD per person, including tip.

Corporate Cards

Corporate cards are issued to managers and above. Cardholders must reconcile their statement within 15 days of the statement date, otherwise the card is suspended.

Foreign Currency

Expenses in a foreign currency are converted at the exchange rate on the payment date shown on the bank or card statement.

title: Business Travel Policy
text:
Acme Corp Business Travel Policy

Booking

All flights and hotels are booked through the Acme travel portal at least 14 days before departure. Late bookings need approval from the traveller's manager.

Flights

Economy class is used for flights shorter than 6 hours. For flights of 6 hours or longer, premium economy is allowed. Business class is only available to directors.

Hotels

Hotel stays are capped at 180 USD per night, or 250 USD per night in cities on the high-cost list: London, New York, Tokyo and Zurich. Breakfast is included in the cap.

Rental Cars

Rental cars are allowed only with manager approval and only when public transport is not practical. Insurance is included in the company rental rate.

Travel Insurance

Every business trip is automatically covered by the company travel insurance. Employees do not need to buy extra cover for medical costs or cancelled flights.

Incidents

Travel incidents such as a lost passport or a medical emergency must be reported to the Travel Desk within 24 hours on +1 555 0100. The Travel Desk arranges replacement documents and medical help.

Extending a Trip

Employees may extend a business trip with personal days at their own cost, as long as the extra days do not raise the ticket price.

Visas

The Travel Desk starts visa applications once the trip is approved. For countries that require a visa, employees must hand in their passport at least 20 working days before departure.

Loyalty Programmes

Employees keep the frequent flyer miles and hotel points they collect on business trips.

title: IT Equipment and Software Policy
text:
Acme Corp IT Equipment and Software Policy

Laptop Replacement

Laptops are replaced every 36 months. Developers may request a higher specification with their manager's approval.

Lost or Stolen Devices

A lost or stolen device must be reported to the IT Service Desk within 24 hours. IT locks and wipes the device remotely and issues a replacement within 2 business days.

Software Requests

Software requests are submitted as a ticket and answered within 5 business days. Open source tools on the approved list can be installed without a ticket.

Peripherals

Each employee may choose one 27-inch monitor, a keyboard and a mouse. Ergonomic chairs are ordered through Facilities, not through IT.

Removable Storage

Personal USB storage devices must not be connected to company laptops. Files are shared through the company cloud storage.

Leaving the Company

Equipment must be returned within 7 days after the last working day. Equipment that is not returned is deducted from the final salary at its remaining book value.

Networks

The VPN must be used on all public networks. Visitors may only use the guest Wi-Fi, which has no access to internal systems.

Support Hours

The IT Service Desk is open from 8:00 to 18:00 on working days. Critical outages are handled around the clock through the on-call phone line.

title: Code of Conduct
text:
Acme Corp Code of Conduct

Gifts

Gifts worth more than 50 USD must be declared to Compliance within 5 working days. Cash gifts are never accepted, whatever the amount.

Conflicts of Interest

A conflict of interest must be disclosed to the Compliance team in writing as soon as it arises. Employees must not take part in decisions where they have a personal interest.

Raising Concerns

Employees can report a concern anonymously through the ethics hotline, which is open 24 hours a day. Reports can also be made in person to Compliance or HR.

No Retaliation

Retaliation against anyone who reports a concern in good faith is prohibited and leads to disciplinary action, up to dismissal.

Investigations

Compliance acknowledges every report within 2 working days and aims to close the investigation within 30 working days. The person who reported the concern is told the outcome.

Outside Employment

Outside employment requires written approval from the manager and HR. Work for a competitor is not permitted.

Social Media

Employees must not share confidential information on social media and must make clear that personal opinions are their own.

Annual Training

All employees complete the code of conduct training before 31 January every year. Managers receive a list of colleagues who have not finished it.

title: Performance Review Policy
text:
Acme Corp Performance Review Policy

Review Cycle

Performance reviews take place twice a year, in June and December. Each review covers the goals agreed at the start of the period.

Rating Scale

Employees are rated on a scale from 1 to 5, where 3 means fully meets expectations. Ratings of 5 are limited to about 10 percent of a team.

Peer Feedback

Every review includes written feedback from at least 3 colleagues chosen by the employee and the manager.

Appeals

Employees may appeal their rating within 14 days of the review meeting. The appeal is decided by the next-level manager together with HR.

Promotions

Promotions are decided once a year, in the January cycle, and take effect on 1 February. A promotion needs two consecutive ratings of 4 or higher.

Improvement Plans

An employee rated 1 or 2 receives a performance improvement plan that lasts 60 days. Progress is reviewed every two weeks with the manager.

Goal Setting

Goals are written in the HR portal in the first month of each period. Each employee has between three and five goals, and at least one is about personal development.

title: Payroll and Compensation Policy
text:
Acme Corp Payroll and Compensation Policy

Pay Day

Salaries are paid on the 25th of each month. When the 25th is a weekend or a public holiday, payment is made on the last working day before it.

Payslips

Payslips are published in the HR portal on the day of payment. Employees can download the payslips of the last 36 months.

Overtime

Overtime is paid at 1.5 times the normal hourly rate for hours above 40 per week. Overtime must be approved in advance by the manager.

Annual Bonus

The annual bonus is paid in March together with the salary. The amount depends on the company result and the employee's last rating.

Salary Review

Salaries are reviewed once a year in January. Increases take effect on 1 February and are announced by the manager in a personal meeting.

Payroll Errors

Errors in a payslip must be reported to Payroll within 30 days of the payment. Underpayments are corrected in the next payroll run.

Pension

Acme pays 5 percent of the gross salary into the employee's pension plan. Employees may add a further contribution of up to 10 percent.

Tax Documents

Annual tax statements are available in the HR portal by 31 January.

title: Health and Safety Policy
text:
Acme Corp Health and Safety Policy

Reporting Injuries

Workplace injuries must be reported to the safety officer within 24 hours, even when the injury seems minor. The safety officer records the incident and decides whether an investigation is needed.

First Aid

Acme has one trained first aider for every 25 employees. Their names and phone numbers are posted next to the first aid boxes on each floor.

Fire Drills

Fire drills are held every 6 months. Employees must leave the building by the nearest marked exit and must not use the lifts.

Evacuation

After an evacuation, everyone gathers at the assembly point, which is car park B. The floor warden counts the team and reports missing colleagues to the safety officer.

Ergonomics

Employees can ask for an ergonomic assessment of their workplace. The assessment takes place within 10 business days of the request.

Emergency Number

The internal emergency number is 555. For life-threatening situations call the public emergency number first.

Working From Home

Employees working from home are covered by the same safety rules. They must report accidents that happen during working hours within 24 hours.

Hazard Reports

Hazards such as wet floors or damaged cables should be reported to Facilities immediately through the helpdesk.

title: Procurement Policy
text:
Acme Corp Procurement Policy

Quotes

Purchases above 5,000 USD require three written quotes from different vendors. The cheapest quote does not have to win, but the choice must be explained in writing.

Approval Limits

Purchases above 25,000 USD require approval from the CFO. Purchases above 100,000 USD also require approval from the management board.

Approved Vendors

Orders should be placed with vendors on the approved vendor list. New vendors are added after a check by Procurement and Legal, which takes about 10 business days.

Contract Review

Legal reviews every contract within 5 business days of receiving it. Contracts must be signed before work starts.

Payment Terms

The standard payment term for suppliers is net 45 days from the invoice date. Shorter terms need approval from Finance.

Purchase Orders

A purchase order is required for every purchase above 1,000 USD. Invoices without a purchase order are returned to the supplier.

Sustainability

Procurement asks suppliers about their environmental policy. Suppliers with a recognised certification are preferred when quotes are similar.

title: Data Retention and Privacy Policy
text:
Acme Corp Data Retention and Privacy Policy

Customer Data

Customer data is kept for 7 years after the contract ends, because of tax and accounting rules. After that period it is deleted or anonymised.

Employee Records

Employee records are kept for 6 years after the employee leaves Acme. Application documents of candidates who were not hired are deleted after 6 months.

Access Logs

Access logs of production systems are kept for 12 months. Logs are only inspected when there is a security incident or a legal request.

Deletion Requests

Acme answers customer deletion requests within 30 days. The Privacy Officer confirms by email once the data has been erased.

Data Breaches

A personal data breach must be reported to the regulator within 72 hours of Acme becoming aware of it. Affected customers are told without undue delay.

Data Protection Officer

The Data Protection Officer can be reached at privacy@acme.example. Employees with privacy questions should contact the officer before sharing personal data with third parties.

Backups

Backups are encrypted and kept for 35 days. Deleted data may remain in backups until they expire.
